name: GO
summary: GO is an Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that trades based on momentum signals. It likely enters positions when momentum indicators confirm directional strength and exits on momentum exhaustion or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention.
summary_zh: GO是一个基于动量信号的MetaTrader 5专家顾问。它可能在动量指标确认方向性强度时入场，并在动量耗尽或固定止盈/止损水平出场。该EA系统性运行，无需手动干预。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于动量交易原理，通过检测价格动量的变化来捕捉趋势的早期阶段。入场条件可能依赖于动量指标如RSI、MACD或CCI的交叉信号或阈值突破，当动量达到一定强度时开仓。出场条件可能包括动量反转信号、固定止盈止损或移动止损。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面可能包含风险控制参数如最大持仓数和单笔风险比例。整体策略偏向于短线到中线的动量跟踪交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on momentum trading principles, capturing early stages of trends by detecting changes in price momentum. Entry conditions likely rely on momentum indicators such as RSI, MACD, or CCI crossover signals or threshold breakouts, opening positions when momentum reaches a certain strength. Exit conditions may include momentum reversal signals, fixed take-profit/stop-loss, or trailing stops. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing. Money management may include risk control parameters such as maximum open positions and per-trade risk percentage. The overall strategy leans toward short-to-medium-term momentum-following trading.
pros: 动量策略能够捕捉趋势早期阶段，获利潜力较大
系统性执行消除了情绪干扰，交易纪律性强
参数化设计允许用户根据不同市场条件调整策略
固定止损提供了每笔交易的最大风险控制
pros_en: Momentum strategy captures early trend stages with high profit potential
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference with strong trading discipline
Parameterized design allows users to adjust strategy for different market conditions
Fixed stop-loss provides maximum risk control per trade
cons: 动量策略在震荡市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上多次开仓
缺少点差过滤器在高点差环境下可能造成不必要的损失
仓位管理可能过于简单，未考虑波动率自适应调整
cons_en: Momentum strategy tends to generate frequent false signals and losses in ranging markets
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar
Lack of spread filter may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
Position sizing may be overly simplistic without volatility-adaptive adjustment
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向）避免在震荡市场中频繁交易
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整风险参数
添加新K线检查和点差过滤提高交易执行的可靠性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit for volatility-adaptive risk parameter adjustment
Add new bar check and spread filter to improve trade execution reliability

risk_points: 动量策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损
缺少新K线检查可能导致信号重复触发
固定止损可能不适合所有波动率环境
risk_points_en: Momentum strategy may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lack of new bar check may cause signal repeated triggering
Fixed stop-loss may not be suitable for all volatility environments
